member.name: T:ERP.Application.Accounting.Queries.GetTrialBalance.ITrialBalanceReadContext
member.summary: Read-model query context — separate, deliberately minimal, read-only DbContext interface (CQRS read side) so reporting queries never share change-tracking overhead with the write side. Implemented against the same physical database via EF Core's read-only query projections in Persistence.

member.name: T:ERP.Application.Accounting.Queries.GetTrialBalance.GetTrialBalanceQueryHandler
member.summary: Handler computes the Trial Balance by summing all posted journal lines per account up to AsOfDate. Result is cached in Redis (see CachedTrialBalanceQueryHandler decorator in Infrastructure, applying the Decorator pattern) keyed by CompanyId+AsOfDate, invalidated whenever a new JournalEntryPostedEvent fires for that company.
